definitions.full: H6770. tsame [ צָמֵא ] verb be thirsty (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew (rare); so Arabic Ethiopic : Assyrian ƒûmu , thirst , etc.); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular צָֽמְאָה Psa 42:3 ; 63:2 ; 2 feminine singular וְצָמִת consecutive Ruth 2:9 (Ges § 75qq ); 1 singular צָמֵתִי Judg 4:19 (Ges § 74k ); 3 plural צָֽמְאוּ Isa 28:21 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּצְמָא Exod 17:3 ; Judg 15:18 ; 3 masculine plural יִצְמָ֑אוּ Isa 49:10 , ׳וַיִּצ Job 24:11 ; 2 masculine plural תִּצְמָ֑אוּ Isa 65:13 ; — be thirsty Judg 4:19 ; 15:18 ; Ruth 2:9 ; Isa 48:21 ; 49:10 (|| יִרְעָ֑בוּ ), 65:13 (|| תִּרְעָ֑בוּ ) Job 24:11 ; with ל of thing, Exod 17:3 (E); figurative לֵאלֹהִים נַפְשִׁי צָֽמְאָה . Psa 42:3 my soul thirsteth for God , compare 63:2 .

occurrences.englishText: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”
He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.”
He was very thirsty, and called on Yahweh and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”
They make oil within the walls of these men.
My tears have been my food day and night,
So I have seen you in the sanctuary,
They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts.
They shall not hunger nor thirst;
